title: Invariance under a fixed bitwise mask
statement: For a natural number $m$, a bit string $c$ of length $m$, and a decidable property $P$ of finite bit strings, choose a uniformly random bit string $r$ of length $m$. The probability that $P$ holds of the bitwise XOR of $c$ and $r$ is equal to the probability that $P$ holds of $r$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a bit string of length $m$
$P$ is a decidable property of finite bit strings
